result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban street with commercial land use and sidewalks on both sides. While the low-speed environment is somewhat conducive to walking, there is a complete lack of marked pedestrian crossings, traffic control devices, or curb ramps at the visible intersection point.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: A pedestrian is shown crossing the street at a corner where no crosswalk markings or traffic controls are present.

hazards.name: Degraded Road Surface
hazards.description: The asphalt is cracked and uneven, which can create trip hazards for pedestrians and affect vehicle braking.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile warning strips and sloped ramps to ensure the crossing is accessible.

result.summary: The image shows a dense urban commercial street with wide sidewalks and a marked continental crosswalk. While basic infrastructure like traffic signals and lighting is present, sight lines are partially obscured by parked vehicles near the crossing.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars on the right side of the street are positioned close to the crosswalk, potentially blocking the view between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, adjacent to the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Extensions
hazards.description: The absence of bulb-outs increases the distance pedestrians must travel in the roadway and keeps them hidden behind parked cars until they step into the lane.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a dense urban intersection with wide sidewalks and signalized traffic control. Pedestrian safety is hindered by significantly faded crosswalk markings and a lack of physical traffic calming measures, resulting in pedestrians crossing in poorly defined areas.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk lines are heavily worn and difficult to see, reducing driver awareness of the crossing zone.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway surface in the center foreground.

hazards.name: Unprotected Multi-lane Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island or high-visibility markings to slow vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection where pedestrians are crossing.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style high-visibility crosswalk markings to improve visibility for drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, reducing conflicts with turning traffic.

result.summary: The image depicts a standard urban intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals. The environment features wide sidewalks and street trees, though the multi-lane one-way street layout may facilitate higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to two lanes of traffic for the full width of the roadway without curb extensions or a refuge island.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection corners to shorten the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to provide pedestrians with a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.
